script.text: In the last round before the finals, Yuya and Crow dueled to see who would face the previous Friendship Cup champion.
Hey, Yuya. I'm sorry. I was convinced you and the other Lancers had teamed up with the Topsiders.
My duel against Shay helped me see that the Commons and the Lancers are really fighting for the same cause.
Whatever happens on the track today, I want you to know you can count on me as a friend.
Crow, hear me out. Roget wants to take over New Domino City.
If that creep becomes ruler, the Commons will have even less freedom!
There's still a chance to shut him down, but it's not gonna be easy. I need your help.
Anything to stick it to Roget!
